u1: The box has just fallen, so the agent is under a strict one-step obligation to be holding it again on the very next step. If the box instead falls and is not held, the task enters a combined pending condition with an immediate pickup deadline. If nothing resolves it, the condition remains pending until the episode ends without proper completion.

The agent must be holding the box on the very next step; doing so clears both outstanding conditions and returns to normal progress. Until the deadline is met, this is a more urgent combined pending condition.
